source_of_truth: Parent roadmap 2026-05-23-003 defines the local-first visual operating console. This child plan integrates design assets and value-first language into the existing V0 dashboard without adding new mutation surfaces or future V1 tabs.

user_journeys.name: non-technical-operator-opens-dashboard-and-understands-what-needs-attention
user_journeys.description: A non-technical operator opens the local dashboard and can identify approvals, blocked work, setup needs, and health warnings without first learning DontPanic's internal vocabulary.
acceptance_signals: Default landing label uses value-first language rather than internal-only nouns
Approval, setup, blocked, running, and health states have plain-language labels
Technical IDs remain available in secondary metadata or detail rows
A static snapshot shows no Jarvis-era branding
Home, Work, and Health have credible All Projects / fleet-mode behavior

user_journeys.name: operator-sees-business-value-before-implementation-detail
user_journeys.description: A product owner or founder reviewing DontPanic sees why a warning matters before seeing the underlying gate, capability, or supervisor identifier.
acceptance_signals: Warning cards include business/user impact phrasing
Command chips still show exact commands
Source/provenance is visible without dominating the first read
The four-band status taxonomy is preserved

user_journeys.name: operator-navigates-core-dashboard-without-demo-noise
user_journeys.description: An operator sees a restrained V0 navigation focused on Needs Attention, Work, Tools & Setup, Health, and Preferences, without Financial or Cloud Costs appearing as core DontPanic functionality.
acceptance_signals: Visible V0 nav matches the plan's surface table
Financial is removed from core nav
Cloud Costs is absent or clearly deferred unless backed by a real capability
Capability-backed adapter views are not shown as core tabs

user_journeys.name: agent-and-technical-operator-can-still-recover-exact-substrate
user_journeys.description: An agent or technical operator can inspect the same page and recover plan IDs, feature IDs, capability IDs, source files, timestamps, and exact commands without scraping prose.
acceptance_signals: Action cards retain exact CLI commands
Technical identifiers are visible in metadata/details
Every rendered page has a consistent source/provenance pattern
No secret values are added to HTML, state cache, screenshots, or docs

user_journeys.name: future-dashboard-work-has-a-copy-and-design-contract
user_journeys.description: A future implementer adding Architecture, Review, Configuration, or Agent Session views has a documented dashboard language and component contract instead of inventing labels per page.
acceptance_signals: Dashboard README or design notes document value-first labels and technical disclosure rules
Status taxonomy and optional relevance chip rules are documented
Future surfaces are named as non-goals, not placeholder tabs
Claude Design assets are referenced or archived without becoming runtime dependencies

non_goals: No local executor or inline mutation path
No new status health band beyond the existing four-band taxonomy
completion_test: A local operator runs `dontpanic dashboard serve`, opens the dashboard, and sees a DontPanic-branded value-first operator console with V0 navigation: Needs Attention, Work, Tools & Setup, Health, and Preferences. The first-read language is understandable to a non-technical reviewer, demo/noise tabs are removed or gated, exact commands and technical IDs remain available, provenance is visible, and the page remains read-only/command-emitter only.
